label: preparing
what: Possibly a concealed fortieth-service anniversary gathering in the great hall, with the lighting inspection tomorrow at 18:00 serving as a pretext. Builder is preparing hall work and lanterns, and secretary is arranging attendance. This is only a suspicion: the stated inspection is entirely plausible, and there is no direct evidence of a celebration or of others knowingly participating. Baker's thirty-two market loaves are not sufficient evidence of involvement.
